The problem with generic plans

Generic plans don't work.
Here's why.

📋

One-size-fits-all plans

A 60kg vegetarian woman and an 85kg man cannot follow the same plan. But most apps give them identical advice.

🔄

Plans that never update

Your body changes. Your plan should too. Static plans stop working after 4–6 weeks because your metabolism adapts.

🌍

Plans that ignore your culture

Protein shakes and chicken breast every meal? Real people eat real food from their culture. Your plan should reflect that.

⚡

Fit Ninja solves all three.

Personalized to your body. Recalculated every month. Built around your diet preference — veg, non-veg, eggetarian, or vegan.

Got questions?

Frequently asked questions.

Is this plan really personalized or is everyone getting the same thing?
+
Every plan is generated individually from your body weight, height, age, gender, activity level, goal, and diet preference. A 55kg vegetarian woman doing 3 days/week home workouts gets a completely different plan than an 80kg non-veg man training 5 days at the gym.
What if I'm vegetarian or vegan?
+
Vegetarian and vegan plans are completely different menus from non-veg — not the same plan with protein swapped out. Veg plans use legumes, tofu, dairy, and plant proteins. Vegan plans use tofu, cashew yogurt, oat milk, and plant-based proteins.
How does the monthly update work?
+
Every week you log your weight. Every month, the app analyzes your rate of progress. Gaining too slowly? Calories adjust. Losing too fast? Protein target increases.
Can I cancel anytime?
+
Yes — cancel from your profile inside the app at any time. No questions asked, zero cancellation fees.
